speak.title: Role-play: come round on Friday?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You want to invite a friend to your flat on Friday. It's a bit untidy and you have no special food. Persuade your friend to come anyway.

b.text: You'd prefer to meet in a café. You're tired and you don't want to see a messy flat. Ask questions and say what would change your mind.

phrases: Why don't you come round on Friday?
I'm afraid the flat's a mess.
I wouldn't mind that at all.
Let's meet at a café instead.
I'll bring dessert if that helps.
That's a fair point, so let's do that.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: where did you decide to meet, and why?
